text.name: cp_player_unload_mod_desc
text.text: Enables Courseplay AI unloaders to automatically unload player-driven combines.

text.text: Courseplay unloader '%s' has been called to your combine.

text.name: cp_player_unload_arrived

text.text: No idle Courseplay unloader found in range.
